meta.title: Recreate Order: Edit More Details
gaps: Directly verify that participants and Terms & Conditions are prefilled on the recreated create screen
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify that participants and Terms & Conditions are prefilled on the recreated create screen

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary required for this case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify the Recreate Order pop-up offers the Edit More Details action.
Open the full create screen for editing the recreated order.
Verify the full create screen opened.
Verify the recreated event retained an applied template.
Verify the recreated event retained its existing line item.
Verify the prefilled pricing sheet rendered on the recreated create screen.
